items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And everybody -- the Dandridge Sisters were in this scene

ctx.x: And my selections were -- As the scene opened, I was -- there was this group of musicians and kids on a lawn of the big house, and I was a maid.

And I was upstairs looking out the window. And I sang to the tune of 'Go In and Out The Window' -- 'I better close the window, I better close the window, I better close the window, they're making too much noise.'

items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Dorothy Dandridge in the context of soundies; Interviewee does not mention a personal connection.

ctx.x: Yeah, it must've been. Those selections were done for, what at that time, a box -- I don't even know what you call it -- in which you can insert a coin and see the picture and see the performance and hear the songs too.
There were quite a few of them made, but the box was not that successful. And so they took it off the market.
